collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQC 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQC 2019 Onwards model which requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this A Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQC 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
